question: Can the A-K5 gate form detect arrangement-borne content at all?
why_it_matters: A FAIL verdict is only meaningful if the gate COULD return PASS on a known content-bearing input. v1 could not answer this (vacuous by construction: no positive pairs, saturated metric, permutation-invariant readout).
conclusion: A gate of this form CAN separate arrangement-borne content from the same-family content-destroyed control, with dynamic range (within 0.98 not pinned at 1.0) and a control that genuinely destroys the signal (sep 0.6065 -> -0.0009).

consequences.for_ak5_verdict: The A-K5 measurement was NOT vacuous as an instrument. The gate could have returned PASS had the checkpoint carried content. So A-K5's negative is a statement about the artifact, not about the metric.
consequences.for_the_contract: The Q1/Q2/SAME-FAMILY-CONTROL design used by A-K4/A-K5 is validated as a content test. It may be reused for the approval-gated content-grounded experiment without redesign.
consequences.for_the_next_experiment: The content-grounded head test can proceed on the same metric and control. The remaining blockers are provenance and scope, not instrument power.
